text: The locker is locked.
source_text: The locker is locked.

text: 这个柜子锁住了。
source_text: 这个柜子锁住了。

text: You spot a trap on the locker, and disarm it.
source_text: You spot a trap on the locker, and disarm it.

text: 你发现了柜子上的陷阱，并解除了它。
source_text: 你发现了柜子上的陷阱，并解除了它。

text: You spot a trap on the locker, but fail to disarm it.
source_text: You spot a trap on the locker, but fail to disarm it.

text: 你发现了柜子上的陷阱，但没法解除它。
source_text: 你发现了柜子上的陷阱，但没法解除它。

text: You spot a trap on the locker, and accidentally set it off!
source_text: You spot a trap on the locker, and accidentally set it off!

text: 你发现了柜子上的陷阱，并很走运的解除了它！
source_text: 你发现了柜子上的陷阱，并很走运的解除了它！

text: You disarm the trap.
source_text: You disarm the trap.

text: 你解除了陷阱。
source_text: 你解除了陷阱。

text: You fail to disarm the trap.
source_text: You fail to disarm the trap.

text: 你解除陷阱失败了。
source_text: 你解除陷阱失败了。

text: You accidentally set off the trap!
source_text: You accidentally set off the trap!

text: 你很走运解除了陷阱！
source_text: 你很走运解除了陷阱！

text: You unlock the locker.
source_text: You unlock the locker.

text: 你打开了柜子。
source_text: 你打开了柜子。

text: You fail to bypass the lock on the locker.
source_text: You fail to bypass the lock on the locker.

text: 你尝试打开柜子上的锁但失败了。
source_text: 你尝试打开柜子上的锁但失败了。

text: The locker's already unlocked.
source_text: The locker's already unlocked.

text: 柜子已经开了。
source_text: 柜子已经开了。

text: While tampering with the lock, you trip up the tumblers. There's no bypassing this lock now.
source_text: While tampering with the lock, you trip up the tumblers. There's no bypassing this lock now.

text: 由于你胡乱摆弄这个锁，你把锁芯弄坏了。现在这把锁再也打不开了。
source_text: 由于你胡乱摆弄这个锁，你把锁芯弄坏了。现在这把锁再也打不开了。

text: You notice that there is a crude explosive device on the locker.
source_text: You notice that there is a crude explosive device on the locker.

text: 你注意到柜子上有强力爆炸装置。
source_text: 你注意到柜子上有强力爆炸装置。
